title: Never playing abroad; Mexico with Troy and ambition to tour
summary: Albert's band never played a foreign country; he went to Mexico with Troy, played border towns, and wishes to travel and do a concert abroad.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Now, what about foreign countries? You say you played in some foreign countries?
In what regards? How did I like it or how was the music? Yeah, how did you like it?
What kind of music did you play?
Well, it was alright, but I was at, well not with my band, with Troy.
Oh, you went to Mexico with Troy? I was with Troy.
My band has never played a foreign country.
Oh, I see. You're down out of there. Never, never played in Canada or Mexico.

Well, on the borderline of Canada. Right. And then in Mexico, Reynosa, but you wouldn't call that. You know, that's right there on the border. Yeah, you played. When you said Mexico City, then you're all the way in Mexico.
Yeah, yeah, but not all the way down there.
But at the height of my ambition is to get to some foreign country before it's too late.
Well, of course, you've always, well you've been building a big reputation in foreign countries. But with that, or in Blackstone's right up that one to countries all over the world.

I don't know what the reason for it is, but I never, I'm never able to get someone real interested in getting me to do a concert. So I would like very much to go first of all, to see the country. I love to see new things. And I'm a very sentimentalist. And things like that touch me when I get to these places. And that's been the height of my ambition. I most certainly would want to do a concert. Preferably Europe, because I have some friends in the world. But the first one that would come would be the one that I most certainly would want to do and do it personally. So dear
